text: A psalm of David: ADONAI says to my Lord, “Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies your footstool.”
ADONAI will send your powerful scepter out from Tziyon, so that you will rule over your enemies around you.
On the day your forces mobilize, your people willingly offer themselves in holy splendors from the womb of the dawn; the dew of your youth is yours.
ADONAI has sworn it, and he will never retract — “You are a cohen forever, to be compared with Malki-Tzedek.”
Adonai at your right hand will shatter kings on the day of his anger.
He will pass judgment among the nations, filling it with dead bodies; he will shatter heads throughout an extensive territory.
He will drink from a stream as he goes on his way; therefore he will hold his head high.
